title: Uniform bounds for the spatial derivative of a compact variation and for its inverse
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E := Ambient n ℓ = ℝ^{n+ℓ} (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+ℓ)), Euclidean norm), φ : ℝ → E → E, ε ∈ ℝ and K ⊆ E, and assume IsCompactVariation φ ε K (Simon Ch. 4, 2.1), i.e. (H1) ε > 0; (H2) K is compact; (H3) (t, y) ↦ φ t y is C^∞ on (−ε, ε) × E; (H4) for every t ∈ (−ε, ε), φ t is bijective and Function.invFun (φ t) is C^∞ on E; (H5) φ 0 y = y for all y; (H6) φ t y = y for all t ∈ (−ε, ε) and y ∉ K. Then for every δ ∈ ℝ with 0 < δ < ε there is B ∈ ℝ such that for every x ∈ E and every t ∈ (−δ, δ): ‖fderiv ℝ (φ t) x‖ ≤ B (operator norm) and ‖v‖ ≤ B · ‖(fderiv ℝ (φ t) x) v‖ for every v ∈ E.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (ε : ℝ) (K : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), IsCompactVariation φ ε K → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x, ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-δ) δ, ‖fderiv ℝ (φ t) x‖ ≤ B ∧ ∀ v, ‖v‖ ≤ B * ‖fderiv ℝ (φ t) x v‖
